dict.string: TalkQTE uses the microphone only after you start it: to show whether there is input and, during a live session you start, to transcribe speech. TalkQTE does not save audio. It sends audio to Deepgram for transcription, with your own Deepgram key, only after you approve that for the session.

TalkQTE reads Apple Calendar locally only after you enable the notebook agenda or pre-call prompts. The agenda shows selected calendars and upcoming events; prompts can pre-fill a session title. Calendar access starts no recording. A title you choose for a session can later be saved or exported with that session.

TalkQTE captures macOS system audio (excluding TalkQTE itself) only during a live session you start, so it can transcribe the other side of a call alongside your microphone. TalkQTE does not save audio or record your screen.
